inputs.content: Combine quinoxalin-2(1H)-one (0.25 mmol) and methyl 2-diazo-2-phenylacetate (0.625 mmol) in dichloromethane (2.5 mL) at room temperature under air for 3 h, irradiated by a 40 W blue LED at 467 nm approximately 2 cm away. No external photocatalyst or additive is used.

P_N and P_O are alternative candidate product connectivities defined in molecules.json. P_N has a bond between the aryl-ester carbon and quinoxalinone N; P_O has a bond between that carbon and the oxygen attached to quinoxaline C2. Their stereochemistry at the aryl-ester carbon is unspecified. The observed product identity, yield and N/O preference are not supplied.
